name: arlo
description: arlo — A Real, Local Operator. Lights-out ops: type your own words and get the real command from your system's own ground truth. Never invents a command.

plugins.name: arlo
plugins.description: The arlo operator: a grounded NL->command fallback for when the frontier is down. Ask your agent for the command you need; arlo answers from your project's real ground truth, or says no confident match. Lifecycle: /arlo:start (setup), /arlo:update (re-sync this project), /arlo:upgrade (pull the latest arlo), /arlo:remove.
